'''2009 2K Event Day 1 Justin Montgomery LS Mind What You Have Learned''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Justin Montgomery]] at [[2009 2K Event]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' MWYHL
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
